name: xmip
description: Validates a cluster's xmip.toml, its Xmip Applications among its sections, or an Xmip node configuration through the runtime itself, as you edit it; suggests every key and value, looks up definitions and references, creates, renames and deletes entries and fixes what the runtime reports; designs the cluster's one xmip.toml view by view; draws a Work Process in BPMN 2.0 and compiles it into its unit; and opens the Operations Web, to see what a change does.

commands.title: Xmip: Open in the cluster designer
Xmip: Add to the cluster's xmip.toml
Xmip: Rename in the cluster's xmip.toml
Xmip: Delete from the cluster's xmip.toml

xmip.server.path.description: The xmip-lsp executable: a name on PATH or a full path. After a cargo build of xmip-core-gui-vscode it is target/debug/xmip-lsp.

xmip.operations.url.description: Required for Xmip: Open Operations. The address of the Operations Web, as Start-XmipOperationWeb -Url serves it, for example https://127.0.0.1:5087.

xmip.runtime.library.description: Required. The full path of the runtime's native library that validates, suggests and edits the configuration: xmip_core_runtime.dll on Windows, libxmip_core_runtime.so on Linux, libxmip_core_runtime.dylib on macOS. cargo build leaves it in module/platform/runtime/target/debug of the estate. The server looks for none on its own: empty, every validation says where to point it.
